about: 3D audit (v6.13): per-species fixes found by putting each generated 3D model beside its SnakeList photo. Each entry overrides the generated look in tools/auto_models.py (keys as in its CURATED: d back, lat flanks, c pattern colour, b belly, t pattern, n marks, hc head colour, tb throat bands, ls/vs stripes, cx colour extras, pat extra layers, h head). 'why' says what was wrong. The log is tools/3d-audit-log.md.
